name: Boutique Recruiter Operations
audience: independent recruiters and boutique recruiting firms
topic: repeatable candidate and client workflows for boutique recruiters

products.name: Candidate Follow-Up Desk
products.product: A lightweight queue that shows which candidates need a response, what was promised, and when a recruiter should follow up.
products.audience: independent recruiters and boutique recruiting firms
products.problem: Candidate communication is spread across email, LinkedIn, calendars, and ATS notes, so promised updates are easy to miss.
products.valueProposition: Turns candidate follow-up into a visible queue with owners, next dates, outcomes, and stop conditions.
products.topic: candidate follow-up tracking for recruiting agencies
products.monetization: $19-$79/month based on active records or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets candidate follow-up spreadsheet, recruiter follow-up template, candidate communication tracker, and recruiting CRM reminder searches.

products.name: Search Intake Scorecard
products.product: A structured client-intake and calibration record for boutique recruiters opening a new search.
products.audience: independent recruiters and boutique recruiting firms
products.problem: Recruiters start sourcing with vague or conflicting requirements, then lose time recalibrating after weak candidate submissions.
products.valueProposition: Makes must-haves, tradeoffs, evidence, interview ownership, and calibration decisions explicit before sourcing scales.
products.topic: recruiting search intake and candidate calibration scorecards
products.monetization: $19-$79/month based on active records or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets recruiting intake form, job intake meeting checklist, candidate scorecard template, and recruiter calibration questions.

products.name: Interview Debrief Collector
products.product: A focused workflow for collecting independent interviewer feedback before the hiring discussion drifts into group consensus.
products.audience: independent recruiters and boutique recruiting firms
products.problem: Interview feedback arrives late, lacks evidence, or is shaped by the loudest interviewer, delaying client decisions and weakening candidate communication.
products.valueProposition: Collects structured evidence, decision confidence, and follow-up questions before a time-boxed debrief.
products.topic: interview feedback collection and hiring debrief workflows
products.monetization: $19-$79/month based on active records or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets interview feedback form, hiring debrief template, interviewer scorecard, and late feedback reminder searches.
